### context: full
SHEET METAL COST INPUT RULES:
  Lines marked deterministic are computed from the measured geometry and will REPLACE whatever you return for them — restate them, do not re-derive them.
  thicknessMm=2.4  [measured from 4 bend face(s) — coil gauge — deterministic, use verbatim]
  blankLengthMm=336  [largest bounding-box dimension × 1.05 trim allowance — deterministic, use verbatim]
  blankWidthMm=252  [second-largest bounding-box dimension × 1.05 trim allowance — deterministic, use verbatim]
  numOps=6  [1 blank + 4 bend(s) + 1 pierce = 6 stations — deterministic, use verbatim]
  dieCostGBP=105285  [progressive die, 6 stations, 847 cm² blank, 170 MPa shear; OCCT parametric says £92300 — deterministic, use verbatim]
  dieLife=1310000  [170 MPa shear at 2.4 mm on a progressive die — deterministic, use verbatim]
  dieType=progressive  [high volume at 2.4 mm: High volume favours progressive stamping — lowest piece cost once tooling amortized — deterministic, use verbatim]
  process=Progressive Stamping  [high volume: High volume favours progressive stamping — lowest piece cost once tooling amortized — deterministic, use verbatim]
  netWeightKg=2.8  [1037 cm³ × 0.0027 kg/cm³ (aluminium, confirmed by engineer) — deterministic, use verbatim]
  shearStrengthMPa=170  [reference shear strength for aluminium sheet — deterministic, use verbatim]

### context: degraded
SHEET METAL COST INPUT RULES:
  Lines marked deterministic are computed from the measured geometry and will REPLACE whatever you return for them — restate them, do not re-derive them.
  Lines marked UNDECIDED are yours to answer: nothing in the geometry settles them. Answer from the drawing, the photo or the part name, and say which you used.
  thicknessMm: UNDECIDED — needs "What is this part made of?" (Steel | Aluminium)
